subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/ phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

I worked for hours on that project but now it is cancelled.

**All my hard work has been wasted.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"All my hard work has been wasted"** means that the effort put into something has not produced any results and is considered lost. (मेरी सारी मेहनत बर्बाद हो गई)
 
• **"Gone down the drain"** is an idiom that means something has been wasted or lost, especially effort or resources. (बर्बाद हो जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **Months of planning and preparation have gone down the drain because the event was cancelled.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Beat the drum** (ड्रम बजाना): To speak enthusiastically about something to generate interest or support.

 
 
• **Example: **She always beats the drum for environmental causes.
 
 
 
• **In the same boat** (एक ही नाव में): To be in the same difficult situation as someone else.
 
 
• **Example: **All of us are in the same boat when it comes to job cuts.
 
 
 
• **Through thick and thin** (हर हालत में): To support someone or something consistently, no matter the circumstances.
 
 
• **Example: **They remained friends through thick and thin.

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Stagnate**.
